name: HMIS106A_HIV_CARE_ART DSDM
description: This section measures client enrolment and continued participation in Differentiated Service Delivery Models for ART care. It tracks clients who are newly enrolled into one of the four DSD model categories during the reporting quarter and clients who remain active on ART while currently receiving care through a DSD model. The four model categories are Group Models managed by Health Workers (GMH), Group Models managed by Clients (GMC), Individual Models based at Facilities (IMF), and Individual Models based in the Community (IMC).
creator: 82f18b44-6814-11e8-923f-e9a88dcb533f

      "name": "HC42a:  GMH",
      "sortOrder": 1,
      "sql": {
        "compiled": "WITH base_pop AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT h.patient_id AS patient_id FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_health_education h
  WHERE h.encounter_datetime BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate
    AND h.dsdm_models = 'GMH: Group models managed by HCW'
    AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_health_education h2
        WHERE h2.patient_id = h.patient_id
          AND h2.encounter_datetime < h.encounter_datetime
          AND h2.dsdm_models IS NOT NULL
    )
),
ag AS (
  SELECT
    ag.age_group_id,
    ag.label,
    ag.min_age_days,
    ag.max_age_days,
    ag.sort_order
  FROM report_builder_dim_age_group ag
  JOIN report_builder_dim_age_category ac
    ON ac.age_category_id = ag.age_category_id
  WHERE ac.code = 'HMIS_106A'
    AND ag.is_active = 1
),
genders AS (
  SELECT 'F' AS gender
  UNION ALL SELECT 'M' AS gender
),
cnt AS (
  SELECT
    ag.age_group_id AS age_group_id,
    mdp.gender AS gender,
    COUNT(DISTINCT base_pop.patient_id) AS value
  FROM base_pop
  JOIN mamba_fact_patients_latest_patient_demographics mdp
    ON mdp.patient_id = base_pop.patient_id
  JOIN ag
    ON TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, mdp.birthdate, :endDate)
       BETWEEN ag.min_age_days AND ag.max_age_days
  WHERE mdp.birthdate IS NOT NULL
    AND mdp.gender IS NOT NULL
    AND mdp.gender IN ('F','M')
  GROUP BY ag.age_group_id, mdp.gender
)
SELECT
  ag.label AS age_group,
  g.gender AS gender,
  COALESCE(cnt.value, 0) AS value
FROM ag
CROSS JOIN genders g
LEFT JOIN cnt
    ON cnt.age_group_id = ag.age_group_id
   AND cnt.gender = g.gender
ORDER BY ag.sort_order, g.gender;",
        "strategy": "CUSTOM+SECTION_DISAGG",
